subject: MAP: Onramp acceptance lane — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA & retention clarifications
messages:
From: Samir Patel <s.patel@oakridgebank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: MAP kickoff: security onramp and retention clarifications

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As we build our mutual action plan for the eval and procurement window, two priority items bubbled up from my side:

1) A short SOC 2 snapshot (ideally the last 12 months scope) so our InfoSec can triage.
2) Definitive answers on data retention and log retention — our legal team needs the maximum retention windows and an option for shorter retention via contractual addendum.

We'd like to lock an acceptance lane in the MAP that includes the SOC 2 review and the DPA redline review. Can you share an initial MAP timeline and any attachments you usually provide for banks?

Samir Patel
Senior Manager, Vendor Security
Oakridge Bank
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <s.patel@oakridgebank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security onramp and retention clarifications

Samir — thanks, really appreciate the clarity. Attached is a short MAP draft tailored for Oakridge (MAP-draft_Oakridge.pdf) plus a high-level SOC 2 snapshot (SOC2-snapshot.pdf) that summarizes scope and last test date.

Top-level proposal (summary):
- MAP acceptance lane: SOC 2 review -> SIG/CAIQ deep-dive -> DPA redline -> final security acceptance signoff.
- Target close: 8 weeks from MAP start, subject to DPA turnaround.
- Retention: default 90 days for session data, logs 13 months (can shorten to 90 days by contract); we'll put both options into the DPA appendix.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which controls your InfoSec needs us to prioritize in the SIG submission.
2) I'll loop in our security lead (I copied Jonas) to capture any technical clarifications.

Attachments: MAP-draft_Oakridge.pdf (attachment stub), SOC2-snapshot.pdf (attachment stub)

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <s.patel@oakridgebank.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security onramp and retention clarifications

Hi Samir, Rafael — looping in a short SIG/CAIQ checklist so Oakridge can mark priority controls (SIG-CAIQ-asks.csv attached). A couple of quick clarifications from infra/security perspective:

- Data residency: We support region pinning for inference and embeddings storage in US-east and EU-west. For your EU customers, we can surface an EU-only tenancy.
- Log retention: Operational logs are routinely kept for 13 months; security/audit logs can be exported to customer-managed S3 with configurable TTL.
- KV cache: no PII is stored in our cache layer; persistent storage is encrypted at rest with CMK.

If you want a short, redlined DPA summary, I can prepare a one-page summary for legal to consume.

Attachments: SIG-CAIQ-asks.csv (attachment stub)

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <s.patel@oakridgebank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@oakridgebank.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security onramp and retention clarifications

Thanks Jonas — that helps. A few follow-ups from procurement/legal:

- Can you confirm the exact SLA-backed retention window that would be guaranteed in a dedicated deployment? Procurement would like a guaranteed maximum of 90 days for customer content in the service tier we plan to buy, and 13 months only if we opt into the extended logging bucket (we'd prefer the 90-day default).

- DPA: we'll send a redline with a standard bank clause for data subject requests and deletion timelines; please flag any clauses you expect to carve out.

Assignee: I'll add our legal reviewer, but Rafael, can you provide the DPA redline summary you mentioned ASAP?

Samir
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <s.patel@oakridgebank.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 17:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security onramp and retention clarifications

Samir — hi, I'm Irene (security & compliance). Quick responses to the legal points:

- Retention guarantees: We can contractually commit to 90 days for customer content in Dedicated and Private deployments (we will add a retention appendix in the DPA that sets default TTL = 90 days and an optional extended logging tier of 13 months).
- Deletion and DSARs: We can meet 30-day initial acknowledgement and a 90-day maximum remediation window for dependent systems; we'll enumerate the exact workflows in the DPA.
- DPA redlines: I uploaded a short summary with expected carveouts to the shared folder (DPA-redline_summary.docx — attachment stub).

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <s.patel@oakridgebank.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@oakridgebank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2026 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: MAP: Proposed acceptance criteria & close timeline (finalize by 2026-05-03)

Samir / Procurement — proposed MAP milestones and owners below. This is intended to be copied into the HubSpot MAP card and used as mutual acceptance criteria.

MAP: Oakridge Bank — Security & Compliance Lane (summary)
- Week 0 (today): MAP kickoff + deliveries (MAP-draft_Oakridge.pdf, SOC2-snapshot.pdf). Owner: Rafael.
- Week 1: SIG/CAIQ deep-dive (Oakridge to mark priority controls). Owner: Oakridge Security (Samir).
- Week 2: DPA redline submission by Oakridge Legal. Owner: Oakridge Legal.
- Week 3: Redwood to provide DPA redline summary + proposed retention appendix (DPA-redline_summary.docx). Owner: Irene.
- Week 4–5: Technical Q&A and verification (Jonas) — limited to prioritized controls and evidence windows.
- Week 6: Final security acceptance signoff (Oakridge SOC sign-off).
- Target close: by 2026-05-03 if DPA turnaround is within two weeks and SIG artifacts are validated.

Acceptance criteria (must be satisfied for close):
- SOC 2 snapshot received and no open critical findings against production controls.
- SIG/CAIQ prioritized control responses provided and validated.
- DPA signed with retention appendix confirming 90-day default for customer content in purchased tier.

Next actions for Oakridge: mark top-10 SIG controls in the attached CSV and confirm DPA redline delivery date.

I'll update the HubSpot MAP and share the finalized MAP card once you confirm the SIG priorities.

—Rafael
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
